messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: service=redwood-serving-1 severity=high — repeated CUDA OOMs and container restarts on pool 'serve-eu-a'. auto-escalating to #incidents :rotating_light:
ryan: seeing lots of 'CUDA out of memory' in node-12 and node-14, GC spikes then container crash.
maya: confirmed. pattern looks like slow KV cache growth + page fragmentation. latency spikes to 600-800ms for warm requests.
jorge: logs from node-12: ```E CudaRuntime: out of memory (OOM) at 0x7fa...\nAllocator: failed to allocate 256MB slab, current usage=91%```
jorge: also `kvcache:page_count` steady increase, compact ops not triggered.
ryan: customers with Dedicated capacity may see elevated 5xxs. noticed 3% error rate on hosted requests to model=redwood-tiny-ggml.
maya: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle batch_size for latency-sensitive routes, 2) enable kv-cache aggressive compaction on affected nodes, 3) route new traffic to fallback smaller model variant. will post commands.
jorge: running compact scan on node-12 now: `./tools/kv-compact --node node-12 --mode aggressive` — ETA ~45s
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaling up pool 'serve-eu-a' +2 nodes (policy: emergency-burst). estimated provisioning 90s.
ryan: temporary config toggle applied to reduce request batching: `REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX=4` (was 16) — monitoring.
maya: also pushed a runtime hotfix to cap page-growth rate: `ALLOC_PAGE_GROWTH_LIMIT=0.12` (hotpatch deployed to rolling 50% nodes). watch memory curve.
linus: watching metrics — node-14 memory drop after compaction, error rate falling to 1.1% :thumbsup:
devx: routing change implemented: traffic split 70/30 to fallback model, TTL 30m. Will rollback if quality regressions reported.
jorge: manual compaction finished on node-12, `kvcache.pages` dropped from 1832 -> 240. no immediate OOM.
ryan: running quick canary on customer-critical org 'acme-inc' — latency OK, no 5xxs in last minute.
maya: customer-impact note: brief 10-12m window of degraded performance for some tenants, a few DED customers hit transient 5xx. no data loss. we should notify CS.
elaine: notifying CS + support with short blurb and ETA for full remediation. creating incident ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-2029
ops-bot: Incident timeline annotation added.
devx: postmortem checklist: preserve kv-heap dumps from affected nodes (node-12, node-14), collect allocator profiles, attach logs to INF-2029.
linus: handoff for next on-call (8:00 UTC): summary -> root cause suspected slow KV page fragmentation + compaction trigger regression; mitigations applied: compaction, batch throttle, page-growth cap, scale-up. watchlist: mem usage trends, compaction success rate, repeat CUDA OOMs.
elaine: assigning follow-ups: INF-2029: (1) run a full kvcache compaction sweep cluster-wide, (2) add a guard in runtime to fallback earlier, (3) add alert for sustained page_count growth over 10m. owner: maya.
ryan: leaving notes in thread and linking perf-dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kv/allocations?from=now-1h
maya: will keep monitoring for next 2 hours then propose permanent fix (allocator defrag + heuristics).\nincident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation stable, no further OOMs for 15m. moving to monitoring phase. :white_check_mark:
elaine: thanks team — creating follow-up on-call doc and tagging next-shift. :raised_hands:
